pages.text: A rare sanctuary — open fields of the giant $(l:plants_and_food)Stillbloom$(/l), the brightest and softest of the biomes.
A Stillbloom's core is among the brightest light in the world, so the dark-loving hostiles shun the basin. It is the safest place to make camp — and a source of $(l:plants_and_food)Lumen Nectar$(/l).
